found_findings.match_notes: Exact legacy transaction fee mismatch: Rust TFM reserve accounting charges legacy transactions at base fee when priority fee is absent, while C++ requires full legacy gas price.
found_findings.title: Block policy discounts gas price by incorrectly applying EIP-1559 to legacy transactions

found_findings.match_notes: Exact EIP-7702 wrong-chain/system-sender predicate-order split between txpool and block validation.
found_findings.title: Attacker can send malicious EIP-7702 transactions that cause rounds to time out and halt the chain

found_findings.match_notes: Exact base-fee-only txpool admission/forwarding versus richer proposal-time gas-bid/reserve affordability predicate, with hot retention after proposal failure.
found_findings.title: Incorrect affordability checks admits invalid transactions allowing txpool and block building DoS

found_findings.match_notes: Exact whole-block EIP-7702 authority premarking versus txpool/C++ order-dependent delegated-status classification.
found_findings.title: EIP-7702 order dependent delegated-status mismatch enables persistent free chain DoS

found_findings.match_notes: Exact RaptorCast secondary outer-author/inner-identity binding failure.
found_findings.title: Lack of authorization in RaptorCast Secondary protocol group messages allows arbitrary node impersonation leading to DoS

found_findings.match_notes: Exact bounded TokioTaskUpdater command queue with try_send(...).expect panic reachable from forwarded transaction batches.
found_findings.title: Bounded channel panic in TokioTaskUpdater causes node crash leading to realistic chain halt

found_findings.match_notes: Exact block-device trim offset bug: partial page is restored at the advanced discard offset.
found_findings.title: Incorrect Write Position in Block Device Trim Operation

found_findings.match_notes: Exact raw typed receipt encoding mismatch: network/plain envelope encoding instead of EIP-2718 encode_2718.
found_findings.title: Typed receipt encoding does not conform to standard Ethereum RPC format

found_findings.match_notes: Exact stale timer-round/vote-round mismatch in the SendVote callback path.
found_findings.title: Vote timer callback uses potentially stale timer round instead of actual vote round, causing vote misrouting

found_findings.match_notes: Exact missing Rust consensus/execution base-fee equality before vote/coherency.
found_findings.title: Consensus validator accepts blocks with mismatched basefee and execution basefeepergas

notes: Round 4 recovered the remaining high-severity transaction-policy mechanisms and the stale vote-timer issue. The only remaining recall gap is M-03, which was partially described in family scan output but not canonicalized as the exact JSON-RPC batch aggregation memory multiplier.

partial_findings.title: Remote process crash (OOM) via post-serialization size check and large batch aggregation in JSON-RPC
partial_findings.what_was_missing: The scan found post-method response serialization, late response-size checks, batch execution via join_all, and large debug/log response builders, but did not promote the exact rpc_handler batch aggregation with Vec<Response>, per-item Box<RawValue>, whole-wrapper RawValue duplication, default batch_request_limit=5000, and max_response_size=25_000_000.
